from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe')
for filename in ['core/application_engine.py','core/outcomes.py','jobctl.py']:
 lines=(repo/filename).read_text().splitlines()
 matches=[i for i,line in enumerate(lines) if any(k in line for k in ('SUBMIT_UNKNOWN','SUBMITTED_VERIFIED','submission_preflight'))]
 print('FILE',filename,'LOCATIONS',[i+1 for i in matches[:30]])
 for i in matches[:5]:
  print('CONTEXT',i+1,' '.join(line.strip() for line in lines[max(0,i-3):min(len(lines),i+6)]))
print('STATUS',subprocess.run(['git','status','--short'],cwd=repo,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout)
